capabilities: Upload the current note or any vault file to a Plik server
Render a Markdown note to PDF and upload it
Zip and upload a folder from the file explorer context menu
Browse local upload history with expiry indicators
Delete uploads remotely and set share options (TTL, one-shot, password)
extras: PDF export works only on Obsidian desktop; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share vault files as temporary upload links on a self-hosted file-sharing server.

relations.evidence: Upload notes, files, and folders from your vault to a self-hosted Plik server and copy the share link

summary: Uploader that sends the current note, vault files, or zipped folders to a self-hosted Plik server and copies the share link.
